svg.aria-label: What I build: AxiomStation (Autonomous no-code AI agent orchestrator. Describe a multi-agent workflow in plain English and watch it get built, deployed and traced.); Override (An adversarial LLM council reviews your employment contract and a judge outside the council decides the verdict.); ClasiCraft (A sleek, minimal e-commerce platform with advanced SEO and role-based employee access control.); Smart Trash Tracker (Track submitted trash in real time and monitor waste collection with an intelligent tracking system.)
